purpose: Build an outcome-blind, hard-keyed DraftKings pitcher-strikeout price-path universe for March-April and June 2026 before any model or economic evaluation.

market_contract.entry_observation: last quote per side at_or_before start_time_minus_4_hours
market_contract.close_observation: last quote per side strictly_before start_time

identity_contract.normalization: NFKD remove combining marks; lowercase; trim; remove apostrophe-period-backtick-hyphen; collapse whitespace; remove suffix tokens jr/sr/ii/iii/iv/v
identity_contract.event_evidence: all distinct pregame vendor player names on the exact vendor fragment, identity columns only
identity_contract.event_rule: at least one exact normalized official-name match and every matched name resolves to the same singleton official game on the vendor Eastern slate date
identity_contract.player_rule: pitcher name resolves to exactly one official player_id inside the hard-mapped game
identity_contract.duplicate_rule: exclude every row belonging to any duplicated final market_key; never choose a winner

success_condition: Every one of the 1,948 complete DraftKings paths receives exactly one terminal state, all source/feed hashes match, every mapped_unique MARKET_KEY is non-null and unique, and no forbidden data is read.
failure_condition: Any denominator mismatch, silent drop, arbitrary identity decision, partial duplicate retention, source/feed hash mismatch, May access, vendor result access, official outcome access, model/economic scoring, production change, or betting authorization.
required_mutations: read vendor result or won -> fail
drop any path without a terminal state -> fail
make identity fuzzy or threshold-based -> fail
retain one side of a duplicated final key -> fail
authorize betting or alter production -> fail
